notes.title: v1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an in-game top 10 leaderboard menu to the title screen for maze and train scores.
[*] Slightly altered the Inspector and Conductor jumpscares.
[*] Every train will now be consistently 25s between each stop.
[*] The Inspector no longer runs off a random timer
Instead, the inspector will continuously spawn with a delay between each. On max difficulty (5), the inspector will spawn with no delay.
[*] Changed how the leaderboard scores are calculated
[/list]

notes.title: v1.01 Patch notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I hope you are enjoying the game so far, despite its bugs and issues. This update focuses on bug fixes and a few mechanic changes for the train scenes.

[list]
[*] The Inspector now moves 10x slower down the train.
This is to allow the Inspector to become more of a "in your way" character, rather than another offensive character trying to kill you.
[*] Reduced the hitbox of the Inspector.
[*] Rotated Cameras appropriately for the start of each scene.
[*] In the second platform scene, there will now be a clear warning triangle showing you the side of an approaching train.
[*] The Lost Children now work differently:
They will no longer disappear on a random timer, instead, when the conductor is found and looked at (while a child is present), the child will disappear and the conductor will update his position or disappear entirely. 
[*] Fixed some issues with the lightmaps in the maze scenes.
[*] Added a regional dropdown in settings to choose for multiplayer
The regions to choose from currently are "NA", "EU", and "AU". Before EU was the only option and this should help with more stable multiplayer within other regions. [b]You must be on the same region as friends to play together.[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where too many lost children would spawn in multiplayer.
[*] Made it easier and more consistent to see the conductor in the window on the train.
[*] Added the version number to the title screen.
[*] Updated the descriptions of the train Inspector and Lost Children.
[*] The current region connected in multiplayer will show in the bottom left corner.
[/list]

- Joey
